description.fun: A cheerful hedgehog in a chestnut-shell helmet, Chespin is so curious that it keeps landing itself in trouble, yet it never sweats the small stuff. The quills on its head stay soft until it stiffens them to attack, and the more berries it eats, the sturdier its bark-like shell grows. With Fennekin and Froakie, it was among the first Generation 6 Pokémon ever shown, on 8 January 2013.
description.guide: Chespin is a Grass-type hedgehog Pokémon and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Kalos in Pokémon X and Y. A tough, chestnut-like shell covers its head and back, and the soft quills on its head can be stiffened to attack. Its design also borrows from a chestnut's spiky bur.
description.tagline: A chestnut-helmeted hedgehog that never sweats the small stuff

description.fun: Quilladin never starts a fight, but it is built like a tank. Its chestnut armour is so heavy that simply carrying it around strengthens its legs, and its tackle can send a trailer flying. It's said to be immune to pain, and Quilladin train their lower bodies by charging headlong into each other. Its name blends 'quill' with 'paladin', a holy knight.
description.guide: Quilladin is a Grass-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Chespin's line. Most of its body is covered by a heavy, chestnut-like shell that it uses to deflect attacks before striking back with its quills. It is calm by nature and never starts fights, but its tackle is famously powerful.
description.tagline: A walking chestnut whose tackle can flip a trailer

description.fun: Chesnaught is a knight in chestnut armour: crossing its spiked arms in front of its face makes a bulletproof shield, and it's strong enough to flip a 50-ton truck. It's gentle and would rather avoid a fight, but it will throw itself in front of its friends. Designed as a creature from a European role-playing game, it has the highest Defense of any fully evolved first partner Pokémon.
description.guide: Chesnaught is a Grass- and Fighting-type Pokémon, the final form of Chespin. Modelled on a hedgehog, a ripe chestnut and an armoured knight, it forms a spiked shield with its arms and uses its body to protect its allies. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Chesnaught, introduced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A gentle armoured knight that shields its friends with its body

description.fun: New in Pokémon Legends: Z-A, Mega Evolution crowns Chesnaught like a king, with gold claws, a maroon fur cape and a coat thick enough to soak up blows. Its shoulder shields come off and sprout spikes into a battle-axe so heavy that even it needs both hands to swing it.
